title: Bebop, the end of the big bands and believing in self-expression
summary: Dance notes bebop and the decline of big bands. Thomas replies that music is self-expression, one must commit fully, and the listeners matter most.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand
